answer: Unique-artifact challenge with rotating corpus. Each agent identity must submit a freshly composed sonnet over a randomly assigned saffron-themed constraint set drawn from a hidden corpus; a validator haven compares structure, meter, and semantic novelty against all prior submissions. Duplicates or template reuse are rejected. An attacker must generate a genuinely new, valid poem per identity at roughly 30–60 minutes of skilled effort each, making mass registration economically irrational without spending capital.
